mode: Read-only source inspection; no builds, benchmarks, code edits, deployment, or public evidence upload
result: PASS for retained framework architecture, explicit source models, and cache workload distinctions; production-certification qualifications remain

findings.assessment: Meaningful TanStack Start/Router and React retained, not inert snapshots. Vite uses tanstackStart/react plugins, React deduplication; Router creates generated route tree with intent preloading/scroll restoration. Document route loaders retain locale guards, platform resolution, legacy redirects and SEO. SSR executes actual server.fetch(Request) including redirect handling. Browser article modules load through Fumadocs createClientLoader/useDocsContent with shared React/component bridges.

Markdown/MDX/includes, structured navigation and OpenAPI remain maintained. Bounded Fumadocs compilation emits independently cached React ESM plus projections, without bundling the application per document. Compact heads and lazy per-document metadata are derived artifacts, not additional maintained authoring. Raw-source hashes now independently invalidate raw search when JavaScript identity is unchanged.

Maintained React ESM, catalog, raw/processed text projections and runtime bridges are authoritative. Routine preparation publishes these without Markdown compilation. Agent publication identity includes module bytes AND catalog entry, preventing catalog-only edits from disappearing behind an unchanged module. Editing requires coordinated article and catalog projections; preserved React interactivity distinguishes this from maintained HTML alone.

Complete root command prepares sources/application/SSR/assets/routes and invokes Nift composition. Each Nift output explicitly depends on prepared HTML. Composition copies raw bytes without interpreting MDX/code examples. This is hybrid Nift/TanStack publication, not native Nift markup rendering or replacement of Vite/React compilation.

Production React renderer, shared plan and bounded worker lifetimes retained. Existing default128/two workers avoids unsupported larger-batch memory claims; private probes rejected larger/lower-heap configurations. No claim of persistent whole-corpus module caches or achieved aspirational memory target.

A.label: Fresh application state
A.meaning: Source-only checkout with installed dependencies retained; derived application/content/payload/SSR/Nift state absent. Authored compiler and application bundle must regenerate; rendered maintained ESM/catalog survive as source inputs. Not cold OS caches.

B.label: Forced full publication with valid reusable artifacts
B.meaning: Root --all explicitly rerenders every route and forces all Nift outputs. Valid content compiler outputs/application bundle may be reused; not equivalent to an application recompilation workload.

C.label: Incremental/no-op publication
C.meaning: Input signatures trigger affected compilation/projections/application stages; renderer fingerprints select routes; explicit Nift dependencies select composition. No-op still validates inputs/assets/route inventory; clean render planning retires deleted routes and skips unnecessary worker/finalizer processes.

qualifications: This review verifies source architecture, not a new independent browser run or exhaustive cache mutation test. Browser/corpus certification remains separate evidence.
CN is separately configured and requires an explicit origin; local Chinese fixture does not certify a complete production CN deployment.
External Algolia/CDN/API behavior and private service/index mutations are not implied by source preservation or local Orama behavior.
Python preview does not implement hosting redirects/content negotiation; provider deployment precedence and Nift build-image integration remain unverified.
Complete-pipeline time and aggregate process-tree RSS must remain distinct from isolated Nift cost and max individual process/phase RSS. Performance aspirations are not acceptance facts.
Final authored raw-source invalidation correctness fix follows captured optimized performance SHA; do not attribute a measured speedup to that patch.
Three pinned dynamic projection fallback paths preserve upstream public projection metadata/text while retaining working article modules; this is corpus-bounded compatibility.
Inherited full unit-suite failures remain qualified; focused checks do not make the entire upstream suite green.
recommendation: Architecture is suitable for an honest local Labs draft with explicit cache definitions and qualifications. Public deployment/evidence publication and production readiness are separate gates.
